other_conditions: Applicant must be homeless and own hassle‑free land in his/her name in West Bengal
Family monthly income must be Rs 6000 or less
Applicant must be a citizen/resident of West Bengal
Eligibility includes those homeless due to floods, erosion, other natural calamities, disaster‑prone areas, or displacement by government projects
The land provided by the beneficiary must be free from all encumbrances
benefits_summary: Provides free shelter/housing to homeless low‑income residents of West Bengal, covering construction costs up to Rs 70‑75 k per unit.
